references.text: The same formulation stating that there was no king in Israel, which introduces this period of lawlessness and moral decay
Repetition of the phrase 'in those days there was no king in Israel,' which frames the narratives at the end of Judges
The concluding verse of Judges with the same thematic statement about the absence of a king in Israel
Description of Dan's inheritance and their conquest of Laish, explaining why Dan sought new territory
The Amorites forced the Danites up into the mountains and did not allow them to come down into the valley, which explains Dan's need for new land
Dan's camp between Zorah and Eshtaol is mentioned, showing the tribe's presence before they sought new territory
Jacob's blessing over Dan, which prophesies about the tribe's future
